title: Daler Mehndi was paid ₹35 lakh for Uttarakhand event, says minister after criticising singer’s professionalism
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi made headlines after Uttarakhand cabinet minister Subodh Uniyal rebuked him during the cultural evening of the historic Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in New Tehri on Sunday night, objecting to his conduct on stage. Now, the minister has opened up that the singer was paid ₹ 35 lakh to perform at the event.

Adding to this, Daler Mehndi was reprimanded by Uttarakhand cabinet minister. Daler Mehndi was offered ₹ 35 lakh to perform In conversation with ANI, Subodh Uniyal shared, "He is a big artist. If a big artist doesn't do justice to their art...He seemed disoriented on stage and didn't seem to be able to even keep standing. Besides this, he was only lip-syncing to his songs. I told him that he is a big artist and he should do justice to his art; he had been offered ₹ 35 lakh to come and perform, but he was not even singing. So, I expressed my resentment."

Meanwhile, Daler Mehndi was performing at the celebration when Subodh Uniyal interrupted him mid-performance and reprimanded him for appearing disoriented on stage. It was alleged that the singer was under the influence of alcohol and was barely able to sing but these allegations cannot be independently verified.
Notably, During the programme, the minister objected to the singer's performance and was heard saying, "You cannot even speak, so how are you going to sing?"

As per the latest buzz, As per a report by PTI, addressing the singer on stage, Subodh Uniyal shared that the audience had come to hear Daler perform and that he was therefore expected to meet the standards they anticipated. The minister also stressed the importance of maintaining decorum, noting that the event was taking place during the religious period of Navratri.

In further updates, A video of the incident has also been doing the rounds on social media. In the clip, the minister can be heard telling Daler Mehndi, "We called you so that our people could be entertained. You are making a fool of us. This is wrong. It's wrong. You have a big name; we should respect that. You were called because you have a big name."

On top of that, Daler Mehndi is one of India's best-known Punjabi pop singers and is widely recognised for popularising bhangra and Indian pop music. He rose to prominence in the 1990s with hit songs such as Bolo Ta Ra Ra, Dardi Rab Rab and Ho Jayegi Balle Balle.
Over the years, Mehndi has also lent his voice to Hindi movie soundtracks, including songs such as Na Na Na Re from Mrityudata and Rang De Basanti's Paathshaala.

title: Rakesh Bedi speculates on extortion angle in Tiger Shroff attack, urges government action to restore film industry's confidence
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Tiger Shroff was fired at in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday. The incident sparked conversations about star safety. In an interview with Times Now, Dhurandhar star Rakesh Bedi expressed shock over the incident and urged the government to take action to maintain confidence in the movie industry.

Adding to this, Rakesh Bedi is shocked by Tiger Shroff's shooting incident. Rakesh Bedi is shocked by shooting attack on Tiger Shroff Rakesh opened up that Tiger’s father, star Jackie Shroff, was an old friend and described both father and son as people who stayed away from row. He shared, "Jackie is an old friend of mine, and we have worked together. He is a very non-controversial, happy go lucky person and so is his son. So, this is very shocking for the movie industry because that man has not been involved in anything as such. So I don't know if there's anything that is not visible to the eye. I do not know what Tiger’s connection was or whether he was going to work with Salman Khan in a movie. I have no idea at all."

Meanwhile, Rakesh shared he believed money was the main issue and that the incident could, to some extent, be a case of extortion. However, he added that ideology could also play a role, as some people might target someone they believed did not align with their thinking.

Notably, The star added, "This is a very serious matter. These are not merely verbal threats, where someone comes and says they will kill you or do something to you and then walks away. Shots have been fired and such incidents have happened before. The police, the government, and the relevant agencies must look into this and determine what can be done to maintain confidence in the movie industry and maintain law and order in the city."

As per the latest buzz, Rakesh also spoke about how such incidents could affect celebrities in their everyday lives. He shared that constantly having to consider security arrangements, whether to go out and what time to leave could become a major restriction, forcing them to live in constant fear and making it difficult for them to work in such an environment.

In further updates, The incident took place at around 7 pm when the star was leaving Pushpa Narsee Park after playing football. Three motorcycle-borne assailants allegedly opened fire at his BMW, with at least five rounds fired at the vehicle. Tiger escaped with minor abrasions and no gunshot injuries, while his driver and a bystander sustained injuries. They were taken to hospital for treatment. Mumbai Police have arrested three suspects in connection with the firing and are investigating the motive behind the attack.

title: Yash urges fans not to nitpick VFX in Ramayana: ‘It will never happen again if we lose people like Namit Malhotra now’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Ramayana team of late held a grand pre-rollout event in Hyderabad where Yash urged audiences to support the movie and avoid nitpicking over its visual effects, saying India needs to protect filmmakers who dare to take Indian cinema to a global platform. Speaking at the event, the star lauded producer Namit Malhotra ’s passion and ambition, revealing that their conversations inspired him to join the movie as Ravana and a producing partner.

Adding to this, Yash made a request to followers at Ramayana pre-rollout event. Yash makes a special request to followers ahead of Ramayana's rollout Yash shared he had a great time working with director Nitesh Tiwari and expressed admiration for his straightforward approach to filmmaking. He also lauded Namit and made a special request to audiences ahead of the movie’s rollout.

Meanwhile, The star shared, “Anybody can dream of making a movie, but only a few people will have that kind of passion, dedication, determination and madness. As an Indian, I am telling you, we need to protect this guy. It's our responsibility because this man was comfortably doing business in LA. Every time I met him, he always spoke about one thing, ‘We all are doing so much and Indians have done so much, but we should do something for our Indian movie industry and I want to do it. I am getting Oscars, but I am not happy. I want our country to be placed at that level and that's the day I am going to be happy.’ This is what he told me.”

Notably, Yash opened up that Namit’s words inspired him to collaborate with the producer on Ramayana, in which he plays Ravana and serves as a producing partner. He then made a special request to followers, saying, “Sometimes when someone tries to do things like this, he has gambled his reputation and money to put this movie on a global platform. Please don't try to find small faults in the VFX, this and that. It will never happen again if we lose people like him now. It will take more years; we will go back in time. Let's see the movie with an open mind. He has always taken every feedback and criticism and tried to do it better. I request you from my side, for once, if you like the movie, let's come together and show the world.”

As per the latest buzz, When the first glimpse of Ranbir Kapoor’s character in Ramayana was unveiled, the visual effects drew criticism online, with some viewers also calling Ranbir a misfit for the role of Lord Rama. body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

CJP National Organisation In-charge Ajinkya Shinde along with CJP Co-Conveners Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das inside the Parliament Street Police Station, in New Delhi. Delhi protest LIVE: The judicial custody of Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka was extended by two days as a new Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) heard the case on Monday. The duo have been in jail since October 13, after they breached security and entered Jantar Mantar , a day after the site was de-notified as a protest site. ...Read More

Delhi Police cites public order concerns over Das, Ranka’s rollout Delhi Police on Monday sought further custody of the duo, claiming their rollout could disrupt “peace and tranquility.” However, CJP ’s legal team countered the apprehension, arguing that there was not an iota of evidence to suggest that the duo posed any threat or that their rollout would disturb public order. On the day of their detention, Ranka had shared a video on his X handle showing himself, Das and the outfit's national organisation in-charge, Ajinkya Shinde, climbing the locked gates and entering the venue. Police personnel present at the site then intervened and took hold of them. Last week, the SEM sent the duo to five days of judicial custody after the Delhi Police argued that “there was a presumption that the accused might carry out a crime” if rolled out. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke on Monday shared party co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka remained undeterred despite spending days in jail, saying they walked into court with smiles on their faces and their spirits unbroken. "Ashu and Saurav’s first crime was waving the Tiranga at Jantar Mantar. Their second crime? Refusing to back down. Even after five days in jail, they walked into court with smiles on their faces, their spirits unbroken," Dipke shared in a post on X. Dipke on PM Modi In a lengthy Instagram post, Dipke accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of using the state machinery to intimidate young protesters and suppress dissent. He questioned the government's decision to keep 27-year-old Saurav Das and 30-year-old Ashutosh Ranka in custody for waving the Tricolour at Jantar Mantar. "The great Vishwaguru Narendra Modi must be feeling very strong keeping 26-27-year-old Saurabh Das in jail and keeping 30-year-old Ashutosh behind bars. This is what strength looks like? Hiding behind the police, hiding behind the courts, is this Narendra Modi's strength?" he shared. Dipke alleged that the duo had been denied timely hearings, with proceedings repeatedly postponed. He accused Modi of projecting strength by keeping young protesters behind bars and deploying the police and security forces against those opposing his government.

Meanwhile, Delhi protest LIVE: Ranka and Das were produced before a special executive magistrate (SEM) at the Mandir Marg police station. In a two-page order, seen by HT, the SEM shared that they had “deliberately breached” their October 11 bonds and the grounds of apprehension suggested that the duo’s conduct “is not above board; rather it shows no respect for law and their habitualness in calling protest at de-notified areas”.

Notably, “Considering the imminent apprehension, past conduct of the respondent and the submissions advanced on both sides, I deem it fit that an opportunity be given to the respondents to file and place on record their submissions in writing within 2 days, with advance copy to the Investigating Officer,” the order shared.

As per the latest buzz, Delhi protest live: Cockroach Janta Party convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka have been in custody since October 13. The judicial custody was extended by two days on October 19. The two, who had been arrested for trespassing on the of late de-notified Jantar Mantar .

title: Bombay High Court directs makers of Tu Hai Meri Kiran to deposit Rs. 8.85 crores before release
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:
The movie is scheduled to rollout in cinemas on October 23.

Adding to this, Justice Amit Borkar substantially allowed AND Movie Products LLP's petition seeking protection of its investment and contractual rights in the movie. The Court observed that stopping the movie's rollout entirely would disregard the money and effort invested in its production. However, it also shared that the movie should not be commercially exploited without securing the co-producer's investment.

Meanwhile, The dispute stems from a co-production agreement signed on March 27, 2024, under which both parties agreed to contribute Rs. 7.50 crore rupees each, plus GST, towards a movie budget of Rs. 15 crores plus GST. AND Movie Products shared that it invested Rs. 8.85 crore rupees between March 2024 and January 2025 but did not receive repayment as agreed.

Notably, Under the agreement, Echelon was required to repay the investment within 13 months of signing the contract or three weeks before the movie's first rollout, whichever came earlier. The Court held that the repayment deadline expired on April 27, 2025, and the later announcement of the movie's rollout date could not extend it.

As per the latest buzz, The dispute escalated after a cheque for Rs. 7.50 crores issued by Echelon through Vishal Rana was dishonoured in January 2026. AND Movie Products subsequently approached the High Court after the movie's October rollout was revealed.

In further updates, Echelon argued that repayment depended on the movie's earnings and pointed to AND Movie Products' participation in Instagram promotions. However, the Court held that promotional activities did not waive the repayment obligation or remove the requirement for the co-producer's consent before third-party exploitation agreements could be signed.

On top of that, The Court directed Echelon to deposit Rs. 8.85 crores, with 15% annual interest calculated from the respective investment dates, within three working days. If it fails to comply, the movie cannot be commercially exploited.

Echelon must also disclose its existing and proposed exploitation agreements, maintain movie revenues in a separate designated account and provide regular accounts. The company has been directed to obtain AND Movie Products' contractual consent before entering into exploitation agreements and correct or withdraw publicity credits that do not comply with the agreed producer credits.

title: Nepal blocks Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan’s Udta Teer, denies permission for public screening
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s soon-to-release Hindi movie Udta Teer will not be screened publicly in Nepal for now, after the country’s Ministry of Communications and Information Technology refused to grant it permission for exhibition. The decision follows a review by Nepal’s Central Movie Censor Board, which found the movie in violation of a provision of the country’s cinema law. The authorities have not yet revealed what exactly prompted the move.

Adding to this, Bollywood actors Sara Ali Khan and Ayushmann Khurrana attend the trailer launch of their soon-to-release Hindi-language movie 'Udta Teer' in Mumbai on September 23, 2026. (Photo by SUJIT JAISWAL / AFP) (AFP) Why has Nepal blocked Udta Teer? According to India Today, a letter was issued by the ministry’s Audio-Visual and Broadcasting Division in which the Central Movie Censor Board examined the movie on Ashwin 19, 2083, as per the Nepali calendar. Following the review, the board concluded that the movie’s production violated Section 8(3) of the National Cinema (Production, Exhibition and Distribution) Act, 2026. Based on the board’s findings, the ministry decided against granting permission for the movie’s public screening in the country.

Meanwhile, The ministry sent the notice to National Cinema Group Nepal Pvt. Ltd., which is based in Aloknagar, Kathmandu. Signed by branch officer Vishal Bhandari, the letter is dated 2083-06-30 in the Nepali calendar and carries the subject line "Regarding permission for public exhibition."

Notably, The communication formally informs the company that the movie will not be allowed a public rollout in Nepal. It refers to Section 8(3) of the Act as the basis for the decision, reiterating the censor board’s finding that the movie’s production did not comply with the provision.

As per the latest buzz, Udta Teer revolves around a Pakistani spy named Bilal Ahmad (Ayushmann), who enters India and suffers from memory loss after an accident, mistakenly believing he is an Indian spy. Responding to a question at the trailer launch about the role, he shared, “It was part of the script. As an star, you are ready to do anything. This is a spy comedy, a patriotic comedy, and a genre bender. I do what the script demands; I'm a director's baby. It is a fantastic script.”

In further updates, Calling the role as ‘the most difficult character’ because of how he had to stay straight-faced amid all the chaos and comedy happening around him. The star shared, “It is the most difficult character because things were happening around him. I had to have that straight face, though there were moments when I felt like laughing, but I couldn't. I had to be normal while there was chaos happening around me.”

On top of that, Akash A Kaushik makes his directorial debut with Udta Teer, which features Ayushmann, Sara, Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Sandeep Anand, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Smita Tambe in key roles. The movie arrives in cinemas on October 23, 2026.

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Indian embassy in Italy has issued a safety advisory for Indian nationals amid protests over rising living costs and poor public services, some of which turned violent over the weekend. The embassy has urged Indians to avoid crowded areas and protest sites, exercise caution and follow local news for updates.

Adding to this, People sit at an outdoor cafe near a shattered glass panel following weekend clashes between police and protesters in Milan, Italy, October 19, 2026. (REUTERS) “Indian nationals are advised to exercise caution, avoid crowded areas and locations where protests are taking place, and follow local news about such events,” the advisory rolled out on Monday shared.
Meanwhile, “In case of any emergency, Indian nationals can contact the Embassy of India in Rome at +39 331 614 2085 or the Consulate General of India in Milan at +39 3881647527,” it added.

Notably, The advisory comes after Milan police clashed with protesters throwing stones and looting shops during demonstrations against poor services and the rising cost of living on Sunday. The clashes followed similar unrest in several Italian cities a day earlier.

As per the latest buzz, Police in riot gear fired tear gas and used water cannons after several hundred hooded protesters broke shop windows and set bins on fire in the area near central Piazza Duomo, sources with knowledge of the investigation told Reuters.
In further updates, The demonstrations escalated as protesters engaged in acts of vandalism, prompting police to intervene to disperse the crowds and restore order in the area.
On top of that, More than 60 protesters were taken to the police station for further checks, the sources added.

title: Tiger Shroff firing sparks outrage: Bollywood reacts as Vidyut Jammwal questions security, Ram Gopal Varma calls it never-before-seen phenomenon
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A firing incident involving Tiger Shroff has shaken the industry and beyond. The firing took place around 7 pm on Sunday in Mumbai, when the Bollywood star was leaving a football club. A video of the incident showed the attackers shooting at his car from close range. While the star escaped unhurt, his driver and a bystander sustained injuries. Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde later shared Tiger had suffered gunpowder burns on his right hand.

Adding to this, Tiger Shroff firing leaves Bollywood shaken: Vidyut Jammwal questions security, celebs demand strict action. (PTI) Police registered a case under Sections 109(1) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Sections 3 and 25 of the Arms Act. The attack has sparked concern across the movie industry, with several actors and filmmakers calling for strict action and raising questions about the safety of public figures. Vidyut Jammwal urged the Mumbai Police to ensure such an incident does not happen again, while filmmaker Rahul Dholakia questioned the law and order situation, asking who would be held accountable for criminals threatening Bollywood and opening fire on the streets.

Meanwhile, Vidyut Jammwal posted on Instagram on Monday to express his concern over the firing incident involving Tiger Shroff. Calling Tiger "the most fearless person" he knows, the star questioned the security arrangements and urged the Mumbai Police to ensure such an incident never happens again. “I would like to tell the Mumbai Police: you have provided him with security, but this must never happen again. If a lapse like this occurs, then you are the ones at fault,” he shared.

Notably, Vidyut also wondered why the followers present at the scene had not chased the attackers. He ended the video with a heartfelt message for Tiger, speaking about their friendship and shared love for the Bajrang Baan. “Tiger, my friend, we both share a favourite, the Bajrang Baan. Just keep listening to it. Whenever I feel truly alone, I listen to the Bajrang Baan. I know you listen to it too. I love you, brother.”

As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram Bollywood reacts Filmmaker Rahul Dholakia questioned the state of law and order after the firing incident, asking why criminals continued to threaten people and target innocents. Expressing his anger on X (formerly Twitter), he wrote, “The ones who are harmless are sent to jail - the ones who are criminals are shooting innocents on the street! A gangster who is in Jail openly threatens Bollywood and shoots at will -and we just allow fear to spread! Who is answerable??”

In further updates, Star-politician Ravi Kishan also expressed concern over the attack, saying he trusted the Maharashtra Police to investigate the case and punish those responsible. In conversation with the media, he shared, “It is very sad. It is a matter of great concern and a matter for investigation. We have full faith in the Maharashtra Police. An investigation will take place, and those found guilty will receive the harshest possible punishment.” Describing Tiger as “a very innocent person”, Ravi added, “I pray to Mahadev and Mata Rani to protect him.”

On top of that, Veteran star Rakesh Bedi shared the shooting had left the movie industry shocked, especially since he believed neither Tiger nor his father, Jackie Shroff, had been involved in any row that could explain the attack. In conversation with Times Now, he shared, "Jackie is an old friend of mine, and we have worked together. He is a very non-controversial, happy go lucky person and so is his son. So, this is very shocking for the movie industry because that man has not been involved in anything as such," he shared.

He also stressed that the incident could not be dismissed as another threat, as shots had actually been fired at the star's car. He urged the authorities to take the matter seriously and ensure the movie industry felt safe. He added, “This is a very serious matter. These are not merely verbal threats... Shots have been fired and such incidents have happened before. The police, the government, and the relevant agencies must look into this and determine what can be done to maintain confidence in the movie industry and maintain law and order in the city.”

title: Shanaya Kapoor's debut web show Student Of The Year: After Dark to premiere November 13 on JioHotstar
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:

The announcement also marks Shanaya Kapoor’s OTT debut. The star will be seen in a role that is markedly different from the glamorous campus setting associated with the earlier films in the franchise.
Adding to this, The first look introduces a darker world at St. Theresa, with the series moving away from the musical romance of the original films and towards a thriller-driven narrative.

Meanwhile, Alok Jain, Head – Hindi & English Entertainment Business (Streaming, TV & Studios), JioStar, “Student of the Year is a generational favourite, and reimagining an iconic franchise for a new format and a new generation comes with both responsibility and creative risk. Karan Johar created a world that became a defining part of youth culture, and with Student of the Year: After Dark, we have consciously chosen to take that legacy in a completely new direction, moving beyond what audiences may expect from the franchise and exploring a world that reflects how young India experiences stories today. It is an exciting creative leap, bringing back a familiar and much-loved IP in a completely new avatar, while retaining the spirit of what made it connect with audiences in the first place ”.

Notably, “When I look at this new chapter, I see a phoenix rising. We began this franchise with big dreams in 2012, and now we’re breaking every rule we set. With Reema’s genre-defying direction and Shanaya’s powerful double-role performance, we’re setting the stage for something spectacular. Shanaya isn’t just stepping into the spotlight; she’s shattering it, and the first look is just the tip of the iceberg”, shared Karan Johar, Founder & Managing Director of Dharmatic Entertainment.

As per the latest buzz, “At Dharmatic, we champion stories that evolve with the times, and finding a partner like JioHotstar, who shares that creative ethos, is nothing short of remarkable. Our soon-to-release project, Student of the Year: After Dark Web Series, is a testament to this shared vision. It’s not just a reboot, but a bold, genre-defying reimagining for a new generation”, shared Apoorva Mehta, CEO & Managing Director for Dharmatic Entertainment.

In further updates, Director of the series, Reema Maya, who is lauded for her daring narratives, brings her signature realism to this high-gloss world. “This isn’t going to be what you expect. It is Student Of The Year, stripped to its bones and reimagined as a thriller competition web series. Karan Johar has put his faith in my voice and vision, and I’m excited to have fun with this genre. The web series format is giving us a wide canvas for the conversations we want to have with our youth. We had so much fun with the music of the show. The cast is young and incredibly talented! Shanaya is a director’s star - prepared and hardworking.”

On top of that, “Student Of The Year: After Dark Web Series for me is more than just a project; it’s a bold statement. Portraying this character in a contrasting manner is a deliberate choice to challenge expectations and redefine what audiences anticipate from mainstream storytelling. The role is layered, flawed, and unapologetically real. Stepping into her world has been the most challenging and a rewarding experience”, says the enigmatic Shanaya Kapoor.

title: Tiger Shroff Firing Incident: Three accused arrested by Kota police while travelling on Pune-Jaipur express
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Kota SP Tejaswani Gautam shared the suspects were caught within 15 minutes of receiving information and would be handed over to Mumbai Police.

Adding to this, Speaking about the operation with ANI, Kota SP Tejaswani Gautam shared the police received information about the suspects on Monday morning and acted swiftly to apprehend them. She shared, "This morning, we received information, prompting us to activate our team. We learned that the three primary suspects involved in the firing were travelling by train and were due to arrive in Kota. Acting on this information, our team, within just 15 minutes, set a trap and thoroughly searched the entire train. Through this swift action by the Kota City Police, we have apprehended all three suspects responsible for the firing. We will soon hand the suspects over to the Mumbai Police. The names of these three individuals are: Rehan, alias Sukka, from Sonipat, Haryana; Hritik Kurmi, alias Roshan, from Begusarai, Bihar, who had been residing in Mumbai, Maharashtra, for the past few years; and one minor. We have apprehended and detained all three, and we will now hand them over to the Mumbai Police."

Meanwhile, Gautam further explained that the police covered exit points, platforms and other locations to apprehend the suspects. The team received information at around 9:45 am, and the Mumbai Police have since arrived to take custody of the accused.

Notably, Providing details of the preliminary questioning, Gautam shared, "Based on preliminary questioning, one of the accused is a Rapido rider. Further detailed interrogation will provide more clarity. The other two, one of whom is a minor and the other, Rehan, work as labourers in Sonipat. Preliminary questioning opened up that they intended to travel to Delhi by this train and then escape to Nepal from there. Rehan had previously been in contact with Anil Pandit..."

As per the latest buzz, The firing incident took place at around 7 pm on Sunday when Tiger Shroff was leaving a football club in Mumbai's Juhu area. According to Mumbai Police, the accused allegedly opened fire at the star's car. While Tiger escaped direct gunshot injuries, his driver sustained injuries in the incident.

In further updates, Sources in the Mumbai Police Crime Branch indicated that the attack may have been planned after the accused monitored the star's movements. The shooters allegedly knew that Tiger regularly visited the Juhu football ground on Sundays and had conducted reconnaissance before carrying out the attack. Following the firing, they as per reports travelled along SV Road through Vile Parle and Andheri, abandoned their motorcycle near Andheri West railway station and boarded a train towards Borivali. Preliminary intelligence suggested that the suspects subsequently crossed the Maharashtra border to evade law enforcement.

On top of that, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde visited Tiger's residence on Sunday night following the incident. He shared the star had sustained injuries to his left hand from gunpowder and glass fragments. Shinde also shared that Tiger and his mother, Ayesha Shroff, were shaken by the incident and assured them of the state government's support.

Meanwhile, security outside Salman Khan's residence at Galaxy Apartments in Mumbai's Bandra area has been tightened following the firing incident. Police personnel wearing bulletproof jackets, along with police vehicles, were seen outside the star's residence.

title: Imran Khan’s plea against ‘Leave India’ notice to be heard on October 26; Bombay High Court seeks Maharashtra government’s inclusion
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The matter was mentioned before a division bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna on Monday. Senior advocate Venkatesh Dhond, appearing for Khan, told the court that the star had received the notice after attempting to attend a protest, where he was stopped midway and had to return.

Adding to this, Dhond informed the bench that the Central government had been served a copy of the petition and requested an early hearing on October 21. However, the court scheduled the matter for October 26 to allow the FRRO time to obtain instructions on the petition.

Meanwhile, During the hearing, the bench also asked Khan’s lawyers to implead the Maharashtra government as a party to the case so that the court could ascertain whether the star had any criminal antecedents.
Notably, “Are there any criminal antecedents? Join State as party, so that in case. This is a local matter. So make State of Maharashtra a party,” the court shared.

As per the latest buzz, In his petition, Khan has questioned the circumstances and manner in which the October 14 directive was issued. He has alleged that the authorities acted in haste without giving him an opportunity to present his case and bypassed the statutory protections available to him as an OCI cardholder. The star has also claimed that the action followed social media campaigns targeting him by political figures.

In further updates, According to the petition, the authorities issued the directive under public pressure rather than through an independent assessment of the circumstances. Khan has sought the quashing of the October 14 notice and an interim stay on its operation. He has also asked the court to restrain authorities from taking coercive steps, including deportation, issuing lookout notices, blacklisting him or interfering with his OCI status.
On top of that, Additionally, the star has sought the production of internal records relating to the decision to direct him to leave India.
The directive was issued after Khan was briefly detained by the police following his participation in demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

title: Imran Khan faces second FRRO notice as authorities initiate proceedings to revoke his OCI status
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to official sources, the FRRO has sought a formal representation from Khan, following which the authorities will decide on the next course of action regarding his OCI privileges. The development comes days after the star was served an exit directive asking him to leave India by October 28.

Adding to this, The matter as per reports stems from Khan’s participation in a peaceful demonstration at Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan, where protesters gathered against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The FRRO has taken the position that foreign nationals are not permitted to participate in political rallies, agitations or demonstrations in India.

Meanwhile, The notice identifies the 43-year-old star as a US national and alleges violations of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, along with related rules and orders. The earlier directive had warned of possible legal action and prosecution under immigration laws if he failed to leave the country by the stipulated deadline.

Notably, Khan has challenged the departure order before the Bombay High Court through a writ petition. In his plea, he as per reports argued that the directive was issued without a prior inquiry, formal show-cause proceedings or an opportunity for a fair hearing.

As per the latest buzz, His legal team has also highlighted his longstanding ties to India, arguing that the authorities had considered him primarily as a foreign national holding a US passport while overlooking his lifelong residency in the country and his status as an OCI cardholder. The petition further contends that the existing OCI guidelines do not expressly prohibit peaceful assembly in a personal capacity. Khan has sought an interim stay on the departure order.

In further updates, The action has also prompted reactions from sections of the movie industry and political circles. Filmmaker Kiran Rao, who has been associated with Khan’s family, was among those who as per reports questioned the measures taken against the star, citing his longstanding connection to India.

On top of that, With the FRRO now seeking an explanation on the proposed cancellation of his OCI registration, the next steps will depend on Khan’s response and the authorities’ subsequent decision. The legal challenge to the earlier exit directive remains a key part of the ongoing dispute.

title: Kalki Koechlin, Abhirami, Nafisa Ali urge fans to send objection emails to government over new draft on animal testing in labs
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A new draft published by the Indian government's Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD) on October 6, titled GSR 864(E), proposes overhauling the existing 1968 and 1998 rules governing lab experimentation on animals. Those who oppose the draft have 30 days to send objections to the Committee for Control and Supervision of Experiments on Animals (CCSEA). Actors Kalki Kochelin , Abhirami and Nafisa Ali urged their followers to send in objection emails and speak up for animals.

Adding to this, Kalki Koechlin and Abhirami spoke up against the proposed GSR 864(E) regarding lab animals. Kalki, Abhirami, Nafisa against GSR 864(E) Kalki made a joint post on her Instagram account with Angels For Animals India. A portion of their caption reads: “If you care about animals, you need to read this and act. India has proposed new rules for animal experiments. The Draft Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Control and Supervision of Experiment, Breeding and Trading of Laboratory Animals) Rules, 2026.” They also wrote, “The government has invited public objections, and this is our chance to speak up. Animals cannot submit objections. We can. PLEASE SEND THE OBJECTION EMAIL, it will take only few seconds.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Angels For Animals India (@angelsforanimals.in)

Notably, Abhirami posted a video on her Instagram in which she explains what GSR 864(E) entails, “If you care about animals in India, I need 60 seconds of your time because you need to know what is happening. A new rule called GSR 864(E) was just proposed, and it changes how animals are tested in labs. Right now, a central government committee monitors animal testing. But under the new proposal, individual labs get to self-approve their own experiments on animals if they mark them as mild or moderate pain. Also, it opens up where labs can get the animals from, making it easier to buy them from open or illegal sources or even use our strays.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Abhirami (@abhiramiact)

In further updates, Nafisa also re-shared an influencer’s video explaining what the news rules would entail, urging in her caption: “Please listen to this video and send an email in support of innocent animals that will be experimented on in India in labs.”
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Nafisa Ali Sodhi (@nafisaalisodhi)

According to Animal Writes , the GSR 864(E), published in the Gazette of India, is a draft of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Control and Supervision of Experiment, Breeding and Trading of Laboratory Animals) Rules, 2026 (G.S.R. 864(E)). It proposes replacing the 1968 and 1998 rules on experiments on animals. The public has 30 days to send objections to the Committee for Control and Supervision of Experiments on Animals (CCSEA).

title: Mumbai fishermen say police stopped them from protesting against Manori project
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A fishermen’s union in Mumbai alleged on Monday that police stopped and detained them while they were on their way to protest at the suburban collector’s office in Bandra east against the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)’s proposed Manori desalination project. The Akhil Maharashtra Machhimar Kruti Samiti alleged that police detained their bus drivers and seized the bus keys.

Adding to this, The fishermen were planning to demonstrate against the desalination project to protect their traditional fishing grounds, livelihoods and the marine environment. The group called it an attempt to suppress the voice of the Koli community. The fishermen were planning to demonstrate against the desalination project to protect their traditional fishing grounds, livelihoods and the marine environment. The group sought clarification on the legal grounds for the police action.

Meanwhile, “For the Koli community, the sea is not merely a source of income, it is our ancestral home, our culture and our identity,” shared Bernard D’Mello, working president of the Akhil Maharashtra Machhimar Kruti Samiti and a resident of Uttan. “Generations of Kolis have lived along this coastline and depended on the sea for their livelihood. Any project that threatens the health of the sea and traditional fishing grounds threatens the survival of the Koli way of life.”

Notably, The group raised concerns about the project’s proposed large-scale seawater intake and discharge of concentrated hypersaline brine into the Arabian Sea, pointing out that the discharge could affect marine biodiversity, fish breeding and nursery areas and the traditional fishing grounds on which fishing communities depend.

As per the latest buzz, They questioned the submissions made by the project proponent before the Maharashtra Coastal Zone Management Authority, saying that they did not adequately reflect the conditions on the ground and concerns raised by fishing communities.

title: Hanuman Ansh producer reveals film's EXACT budget for the FIRST time; also reveals that Haldiram invested Rs. 1.25 cr in the SLEEPER blockbuster
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Talking to The Economic Times, Namrata Singh shared, “The movie was made at a total cost of Rs 1.7 crore rupees. Haldiram’s provided Rs 1.25 crore rupees towards prints and advertising (P&A) as part of the co-production arrangement. Of the P&A budget, we spent approximately Rs. 65-70 lakhs on marketing, with the remaining amount going towards the rollout. We wanted to ensure that the movie remained in theatres for three weeks, which involved an additional expenditure of over Rs. 40 lakhs. The overall expenditure, including production and P&A, was approximately Rs. 2.95 crore rupees or close to Rs. 3 crore rupees.”

Adding to this, She further shared, “One of the movie’s producers, Ragini Sona, is director Vishal Chaturvedi’s friend. They have known each other for a long time. They used to recite the Hanuman Chalisa together as part of a Hanuman club they ran. So, when we needed funding, Vishal approached her. She is an experienced producer. Her insights were valuable. When nobody else was willing to invest, Ragini offered to contribute Rs. 50 lakhs on the condition that someone else matched the amount. When no one came forward, I invested Rs. 50 lakhs from my mutual fund savings. That is how we managed to complete production.”

Meanwhile, Namrata Singh added, “We needed additional funding for post-production. That is when Anupriya A Nagar, daughter of the UK-based financier Anshul Nagar, came on board as an investor, and she financed the post-production.”

Notably, She also shared, “We had a shareholders' agreement. The arrangement was structured around the four of us, with each holding a 25% share in the IP, along with a three-year lock-in period and other agreed terms.”

title: Tiger Shroff’s real name is Jai Hemant Shroff: Actor once revealed the funny childhood story behind his famous nickname
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Tiger Shroff is in the headlines after three men on motorcycles allegedly opened fire at his vehicle on Sunday evening. While he escaped without serious injury, his driver and an auto-rickshaw driver sustained bullet injuries. Both are shared to be stable. Mumbai Police formed 15 teams to track down the attackers, and the case has been transferred to Mumbai authorities. Since then, three suspects have been as per reports arrested and are being brough back to Mumbai.

Adding to this, Jai Hemant Shroff to Tiger: How Jackie Shroff’s son got his famous name, which stuck from childhood. (AFP) Tiger has been in the movie industry for over a decade. He made his debut in 2014 with Heropanti opposite Kriti Sanon. The star is known for his action-packed films, impressive dance moves and martial arts skills. But not everyone knows that Tiger was not the name he was given at birth. The star, who is the son of star Jackie Shroff, was born Jai Hemant Shroff, and collected his now-famous nickname as a child because of a very funny reason.

Meanwhile, Born on March 2, 1990, to star Jackie Shroff and Ayesha Shroff, Tiger was named Jai Hemant Shroff. His childhood nickname, however, eventually became the name the world knows him by. The reason was rather unusual: he would bite people around him, including those at school.

Notably, In a May 2014 interview with Hindustan Times, the star spoke about how the name came about. “I used to bite as a kid ... like bite everyone around.” The habit sometimes landed him in trouble. Recalling one such incident, he shared, “I bit my teacher in school, and even got punished for that.”

As per the latest buzz, Tiger told the same story on the YouTube channel Curly Tales while promoting Bade Miyan Chote Miyan in 2024 with Akshay Kumar. “I used to bite people when I was a kid and that is pretty much how I got my name,” he shared. Akshay was amused by the revelation and responded, “That's amazing.”

In further updates, The star also explained how his birth name came together. His father's real name is Jai Kishen, while his uncle is named Hemant. He shared, “It was my way of showing affection in greeting people, seedha kaat leta tha (I just used to bite them). My name was Jai Hemant. My father's name is Jai Kishen, which became Jackie in the movies. My uncle's name is Hemant and that is how it became Jai Hemant Shroff. Since childhood, people just kept calling me Tiger and that's how it became my name. I officially changed my name in the movies as well”

On top of that, Meanwhile, after the incident on Sunday evening, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde visited Tiger at his residence after the star was back from the hospital. Photographs from the visit showed the star with bandages on his hand.

In conversation with the media, Eknath shared the star had suffered injuries to his left hand from gunpowder and glass fragments. "I met with the star; he has injuries on his left hand caused by gunpowder and shards of glass."

title: Shashi Tharoor rejects ‘regime change’ charge as anti-EC protests continue
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Congress MP Shashi Tharoor on Monday rejected the BJP's charge that the Opposition was seeking to bring about “regime change” in India, saying its demand was for free and fair elections and that the issue was constitutional, not an attempt to topple the government.

Adding to this, Shashi Tharoor shared there was “no point distorting a phrase like ‘regime change.’” (ANI) Responding to Union parliamentary affairs minister Kiren Rijiju's remarks, Tharoor shared comparisons between India, Bangladesh and France were not relevant. He also distanced the Opposition from the violence witnessed in France, stressing that it believed in peaceful protests.
Meanwhile, “I think that India is not Bangladesh and India is not France. I don't see these analogies as particularly relevant,” Tharoor shared in Thiruvananthapuram.
Notably, “We would never condone any of the violence, setting alight buses and police stations and so on, that has occurred in France. We only believe in peaceful protest,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, The Congress MP shared the Opposition's demand was rooted in concerns over electoral rolls and the process through which voters' names had allegedly been deleted. “What we are calling for is free and fair elections,” he shared, adding that the issue was “a constitutional issue” and not an attempt to topple the government.

In further updates, #WATCH | Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam | n Union Minister Kiren Rijiju's statement, Congress MP Shashi Tharoor says, "I think that India is not Bangladesh and India is not France. I don't see these analogies as particularly relevant... We would never condone any of the violence, setting alight buses and police stations and so on, that has occurred in France. We only believe in peaceful protest... that's the kind of protest that I have participated in, and that I believe the opposition in general supports... As far as the larger issues are concerned, there's no point distorting a phrase like 'regime change' and so on... What we are calling for is free and fair elections... What is troubling today is that large numbers of people have been cut from the electoral rolls as the result of a completely troublesome, irregular, and partially illegal process. This is why we are calling for all this to be undone... It's a constitutional issue. It's not an issue of trying to topple a regime or anything like that..." He adds, "...Democracy is not a gift of anybody... we, the ordinary citizens of India, are the custodians of it... Every Indian citizen has the right to protect our democracy... All I'm saying is we are asking institutions like the Election Commission to behave themselves, to perform as they are required to by the democratic Constitution of India. That's all it is. I'm not in any way challenging these institutions as institutions. I'm challenging the way they are behaving, the way they are conducting themselves, and that is something that honestly all of us in India should be concerned about..."

On top of that, Tharoor alleged that large numbers of people had been removed from electoral rolls through what he described as a “completely troublesome, irregular, and partially illegal process”. He was referring to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, against which the Opposition has raised concerns.
“This is why we are calling for all this to be undone,” he shared, reiterating that the demand was not aimed at bringing down the government.

title: Mika Singh says firing at Tiger Shroff raises serious concerns for Mumbaikars' safety; urges government action
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Shots were fired by three unidentified men at Tiger Shroff in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday evening. While the star did not sustain any bullet injuries, his driver and a bystander were injured in the scuffle. Gangster Lawrence Bishnoi’s associate, Anil Pandit, has since claimed responsibility for the incident in a social media post, linking it to his association with Salman Khan. Singer Mika Singh wished Tiger a speedy recovery and urged the government to take action and accountability.

Adding to this, Mika posted a video on his Instagram in which he discussed the firing at Tiger in Mumbai. He recalled coming to the city in the early 2000s and believing it was the safest in the world. “To have this happen to Tiger, especially during the festive season, I believe the government should take strict action. What happened to Tiger today can happen to anyone tomorrow,” he shared in the video.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Mika Singh (@mikasingh)

Notably, He wrote in his caption, “Mumbai has always been known as one of the safest cities in India, where people—especially women—have felt confident walking, working, and travelling even late at night. But after the incident involving Tiger Shroff, it raises serious concerns about our safety. No one should have to live in fear on the streets of our own city.”

As per the latest buzz, “I sincerely request the government and the concerned authorities to take this matter seriously and ensure the safety of every citizen. We need stronger action and accountability so that Mumbai continues to be a city where everyone feels safe, day or night,” further read Mika’s caption, adding, “Wishing Tiger Shroff a speedy recovery.”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Hindustan Times (@hindustantimes)

On top of that, Bishnoi’s associates Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu have as per reports claimed responsibility for the attack on Tiger in a social media post. “We had called him and tried to explain things to him, but he did not understand. So today, we made sure to explain it to him properly,” read their post in Hindi, adding, “Anyone in the Mumbai movie industry who does not listen to us or works with Salman Khan will be next. Wait and watch.”

Three suspects were detained at the Kota railway station on Monday morning while travelling on a train from Mumbai to Delhi. The case has now been handed over to the Mumbai police. Kota SP Tejaswani Gautam told ANI, “Based on preliminary questioning, one of the accused is a Rapido rider. Further detailed interrogation will provide more clarity. The other two, one of whom is a minor and the other, Rehan, work as labourers in Sonipat. Preliminary questioning opened up that they intended to travel to Delhi by this train and then escape to Nepal from there.”

Adding to this, Shots were fired at Tiger Shroff in Mumbai on Sunday evening. Lawrence Bishnoi's gang claimed responsibility and cited his association with Salman Khan. Salman Khan Salman is alleged to have poached blackbucks , an animal sacred to the Bishnoi community, while shooting Hum Saath-Saath Hain in Jodhpur in 1998. Bishnoi issued his first public death threat against the star in 2018. Following Sidhu Moosewala’s death in 2022, Salman was warned he would meet the same fate. Threatening emails and warning shots outside his Bandra residence have continued since then.

Meanwhile, In 2023, unidentified gunmen opened fire outside Gippy Grewal’s Canadian home and as per reports, four bullets were fired at a parked Lamborghini car parked outside his home. Bishnoi’s gang claimed responsibility in a social media post, citing his association with Salman. On Shekhar Suman's chat show Shekhar Tonite this year, Gippy shared , “We didn't even have a close friendship. But they assumed otherwise, and that led to the incident.” No arrests have been made yet.

Notably, In 2024, 14 gunshots were fired, and an arson attack took place outside AP Dhillon ’s UK home. An associate of Bishnoi claimed responsibility for it via a social media post. The attack was as per reports carried out to threaten Dhillon for his collaboration on the music video Old Money with Salman. In 2025, an Indian national in the UK on a student visa who filmed the shooting pleaded guilty. He was sentenced to 6 years' jail, and in 2026, his deportation was ordered. Another co-suspect as per reports remains at large.

A second drive-by shooting occurred a month later, with Bishnoi associates claiming responsibility and citing Kapil's inviting Salman to the Great Indian Kapil Show on Netflix as the reason. A third attack occurred at the cafe again, two months later, with gunmen opening fire from a vehicle. This year, they targeted Kapil’s Chai Sutta Bar in May and issued a warning on social media, asking him to ‘get in line’.

On top of that, In February this year, gunshots were fired outside Rohit Shetty’s Mumbai home, with investigators linking it to Bishnoi’s gang. In the same month, Ranveer Singh’s manager received a threatening WhatsApp message demanding between ₹ 1 and 10 crore rupees. The star also receives a second note warning him and Rohit to ‘fall in line’ or face targeting. The voice notes have been traced to Harry Boxer, aka Harman Sandhu, Bishnoi’s associate. A lookout circular (LOC) has been issued against him.

On October 18 in Mumbai, three assailants opened fire on Tiger Shroff’s car in Juhu in a drive-by. Videos show three men on a bike. One of them opened fire, injuring the star’s driver and a bystander. Tiger did not sustain any bullet injuries. An audio message by Bishnoi’s aide, Anil Pandit, from an X (formerly Twitter) account named Harman Sandhu surfaced, claiming responsibility.

title: JNU hunger strike: CPI(M) lawmaker John Brittas writes to President Murmu
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Communist Party of India (Marxist) Rajya Sabha member John Brittas has written to President Droupadi Murmu, seeking urgent intervention over the indefinite hunger strike of Jawaharlal Nehru University Students’ Union (JNUSU) representatives and other students over a charter of 13 demands.

Adding to this, CPI(M) Rajya Sabha member John Brittas. (X) The demands include revoking the rustication of JNUSU office bearers, reinstating the Gender Sensitisation Committee Against Sexual Harassment and the JNU entrance exam. The strike entered its 16th day on Monday.

Meanwhile, “The failure of the university administration to address the genuine and longstanding concerns of the student community has led to this continuing protest and contributed to the deteriorating health of the participating students,” shared Brittas in the letter dated October 18 (Sunday).

Notably, He asked the President, who holds the highest statutory position in the university’s governance as the visitor, to take steps to revoke the rustication orders and resolve the outstanding grievances quickly.
As per the latest buzz, Brittas wrote a separate letter to the Union education minister Pralhad Joshi on the same issue.

In further updates, He described the hunger strike as an extreme form of peaceful protest. He referred to the rustication and argued that keeping elected representatives off campus strikes at the working of the union. “The exclusion of elected representatives from the University directly affects the functioning of the Students’ Union and weakens the mechanism through which students collectively articulate their grievances,” he wrote.

On top of that, On the Chief Proctor Office Manual, he wrote that its continued enforcement provides for exorbitant fines and stringent disciplinary measures over forms of protest and assembly. Brittas shared this raises serious concerns about the space for legitimate democratic expression within the university.

Brittas cited his own student days at JNU. “During my years as a student at JNU, I too participated in the debates, discussions and democratic activities that have long been an integral part of the University’s academic life,” he wrote. He shared this makes him particularly conscious of the need for an environment where students can freely question arbitrary decisions and raise concerns together.

title: Long distance: India’s protest sites drift from power centres
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Vinay Sreenivasa spent three years fighting the restriction of protests in Bengaluru to a single, low-visibility ground: Freedom Park, the site of a former central jail in Gandhi Nagar. So, when flash protests erupted across Delhi last week — small groups marching through Connaught Place, Sansad Marg and Dilli Haat INA, with some even attempting to reclaim the barricaded stretch of Jantar Mantar after it was denotified as a designated site — the lawyer-activist who runs the Campaign for the Right to Protest recognised the pattern.

Adding to this, Activists hold placards with slogans reading 'Reclaim Jantar Mantar', 'Rollback SIR', and 'Gyanesh Kumar Must Resign' during a protest march organized by Justice Morcha from the Press Club of India to Jantar Mantar, (PTI) It is not just in Bengaluru and Delhi that the geography of protest has been shifting. In several major cities across the country, demonstrations are increasingly being channelled into designated spaces away from centres of power and public attention.

Meanwhile, Urbanists and activists say this is changing not just where citizens can make their voices heard, but also how public spaces are used, who gets access to them, and what role they play in a city’s political life.

Notably, “What the cities are trying to do is exercise spatial control and lock up dissent. Public spaces should be left to the public,” Sreenivasa shared. “Protest should be allowed at the relevant site: outside the municipal office that has ordered an eviction, outside the transport corporation that has hiked bus fares, anywhere in the city where the grievance arises. But, that is no longer possible,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, In Mumbai, large protests that could once be organised at Girgaon Chowpatty, Hutatma Chowk and August Kranti Maidan are now concentrated in a heavily policed corner of Azad Maidan. In Chennai, demonstrations that were once held along the open promenade of Marina Beach have been restricted to designated inland stretches such as Valluvar Kottam and Swami Sivananda Salai.

In further updates, In Kolkata, processions that once moved freely through the Maidan and Esplanade are now often directed into small, cordoned lanes such as Rani Rashmoni Avenue or the gated enclosure of Metro Channel (Y-Channel).

On top of that, “Where citizens are allowed to protest in a city reflects how a city accommodates dissent,” shared Aditya Sharma, an author who participated in the recent Jantar Mantar protests. “The distance between a protest site and the seat of power can determine how visible a grievance becomes, how easily people can gather and whether those in power can see, hear or ignore them.”

In Bengaluru, the restrictions came in stages. Under a 2009 order, protests involving more than 250 people required a licence, but demonstrations were not confined to a single venue. In 2021, after protests disrupted morning traffic, a high court judge wrote to the chief justice, triggering a suo motu public interest litigation. While the case was pending, the police commissioner issued a new order, which came into effect in early 2022 and restricted protests to Freedom Park.

title: Addinath Kothare opens up on first day of shoot on the set of Ramayana with Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey in Ayodhya | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ramayana is inarguably the biggest and most anticipated movie of 2026. On the auspicious occasion of the beginning of Navratri on Sunday, the makers opened up that the Nitesh Tiwari directorial will hit theatres worldwide on November 5, three days before Diwali.

Adding to this, Addinath Kothare has spoken about Ramayana. Envisioned as a two-part epic, the movie will bring the story of the Ramayana to the big screen on a grand scale. It stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. Marathi star Addinath Kothare stars as Bharath in the magnum opus.

Meanwhile, In conversation with HT, Addinath shared his experience about working on the movie. He recalled memories of entering the set on the first day on set and shared, “It was absolutely surreal. I remember the first day of shoot when I was there and we were shooting something in Ayodhya… the whole cast was there. Ranbir [Kapoor], Ravi [Dubey], Sai [Pallavi], and everyone. Obviously when you are shooting in that flow then you are not affected by it as one has to be in that character… but I remember coming back home and sitting with my family and thinking, ‘What just happened today!’”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Addinath M Kothare (@adinathkothare)

As per the latest buzz, He went on to add, “I am part of something that is so huge. Nitesh [Tiwari] sir, Namit [Malhotra] sir, the DoP Pankaj Kumar… we have the best team in the world. We have grown up with their music, The Dark Knight and all the other films he has scored… I am part of such a prestigious venture, I feel God has been kind to me that I am in this project.”

Ramayana is a two-part movie, with the first part releasing on Diwali 2026 and the second on Diwali 2027.

title: Prahaar box office collection day 3: Rajkummar Rao film crosses ₹9 crore, surpasses lifetime haul of Kangana Ranaut’s Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Prahaar ticket-window earnings Day 3: Rajkummar Rao’s latest movie, Prahaar : The Ujjwal Nikam Story, opened to a slow start at the ticket-window on Friday. The movie witnessed a rise in collections over the weekend, but the growth was not substantial enough to give its overall earnings a major boost. Here’s a look at the movie’s box-office performance.

Adding to this, A still from Prahaar. Prahaar ticket-window earnings Day 3 Prahaar : The Ujjwal Nikam Story opened in theatres on Friday, October 16, earning ₹ 2.35 crore rupees in India net collections, according to Sacnilk. With an occupancy of 13%, the movie had a modest start, making it one of the lower openers in Rajkummar Rao’s career.

Meanwhile, The movie witnessed an improvement on Saturday, collecting ₹ 3.15 crore rupees, a jump of around 34% over its opening-day figures. Its occupancy also rose to 17%, indicating some growth in audience turnout over the weekend. On Sunday, the movie continued its theatrical run almost at the same pace, earning ₹ 3.50 crore rupees . This brings the movie's total net India collection to ₹ 9 crore rupees.

Notably, Despite its modest opening, Prahaar surpassed the collections of some recent Hindi releases. Imtiaz Ali’s critically acclaimed movie Main Vaapas Aaunga collected around ₹ 5.5 crore rupees during its first three days in theatres. Prahaar crossed this number within the first two days of rollout. The movie has also surpassed the lifetime India net collection of Kangana Ranaut’s Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata , which collected ₹ 7.04 crore rupees.

As per the latest buzz, Prahaar is also competing at the ticket-window with Yami Gautam’s Nayyi Navelli. The movie, which rolled out on the same day, has stayed ahead of Prahaar and has crossed the ₹ 10 crore rupees mark within the same period.

In further updates, Directed by Avinash Arun and produced by Dinesh Vijan under Maddock Films, Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story is a biographical courtroom drama starring Rajkummar Rao as public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam.

On top of that, The movie revisits some of the landmark cases handled by Nikam- the prosecution of Ajmal Kasab, the lone surviving terrorist captured after the 2008 Mumbai attacks. It also explores the legal battles and challenges involved in pursuing justice in high-profile criminal cases. The cast includes Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher and Lalit Prabhakar, who plays Kasab.

It is produced by Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma.

On top of that, A part of Hindustan Times'review read, "Nayyi Navelli is a movie that mistakes excess for entertainment and confusion for complexity. Its basic storyline offers enough scope for a blend of mythology and comedy, but the execution fails to do justice to the ideas. The screenplay needed sharper writing, yet it keeps piling on subplots and eccentric characters, hoping that something will eventually click. Yami tries to hold things together, but even her performance cannot compensate for the narrative's shortcomings. ‘Nayyi Navelli’ may mean something new, but there is precious little that's fresh about the movie itself."

title: Exclusive| From being a Kanjak to hosting one, Divya Dutta says: It’s role reversal for me
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kanjak Pujan, also known as Kanya Pujan, is observed on Ashtami or Navami during Navratri, when young girls are worshipped as manifestations of Goddess Durga. For star Divya Dutta , who celebrates the ritual every year, it has taken on a special meaning as she now welcomes her niece and other young girls for the puja.

Adding to this, Divya Dutta with her niece “Today, it’s role reversal for me. I celebrate with my niece and other girls, wash their feet and seek blessings. It’s about respecting and loving girls as a roop of Mata Rani,” she says.

Meanwhile, Her connection to the ritual dates back to her childhood in Delhi. “I would get at least 10 invites. One never felt as much in demand. There would be a competition among friends about who got the most invites,” she recalls.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

As per the latest buzz, Her first memory of Kanjak Pujan remains particularly special. “An aunty a sked me to show my feet, poured water and cleaned it, after which she took aashirwad. I felt respected and looked up to, I will always hold that memory close to my heart,” she says.

In further updates, Her childhood memories also include the ritual’s traditional treats and token money. “My first token amount was ₹ 10. I kept it in my gullak and refused to share it with anyone,” she laughs. The traditional poori, halwa and channa, she adds, remain among the fond memories she associates with the festival.

title: HT Evening Brief October 18: 1,800 arrested in France over violent protests, CJP to restrategise and more
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Good evening! Here's your 5-minute wrap of the day's top headlines from across the country, the world and the field of sports and entertainment.

Adding to this, France on Sunday woke up to devastated streets after clashes between police and protesters amid marches against rising costs of living (Reuters) France protests turn violent, 1,800 arrested France witnessed widespread violence during nationwide protests against high inflation and the rising cost of living, with clashes, looting and arson reported across several cities. Interior minister Laurent Nunez shared around 1,800 people had been arrested, while the interior ministry estimated that 5,50,000 people attended the demonstrations. Nearly 1,500 shops and retailers were as per reports damaged. Limoges’ 19th-century town hall was set on fire, while businesses in Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, Marseille and other cities were attacked. Read more

Meanwhile, Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke shared the party would regroup and decide its next steps after spokespersons Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka return from custody. The party has been protesting against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Election Commission of India's Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Dipke alleged that the arrests and detentions were intended to intimidate the party, adding that it would not back down. He was granted conditional bail on Saturday after being detained and arrested during the protests. Read more

Notably, Families of victims killed when a truck rammed into devotees near Shitala Mata Temple in Gwalior alleged that police failed to provide timely assistance after the accident. The incident occurred around 1:30 am on Sunday when a paddy-laden truck as per reports lost control, broke through barricades and struck devotees, killing 15 people and injuring 27. Victims' relatives questioned how the truck was allowed into the area. Read more

As per the latest buzz, India captain Shreyas Iyer will have an opportunity to strengthen his T20I leadership credentials in the soon-to-release five-match series against New Zealand, starting October 22 in Christchurch. Since taking charge in June, Iyer has led India to 11 wins and eight defeats in 21 matches, with two games ending without a result. India of late drew a five-match series against the West Indies 2-2 after the final game was abandoned due to rain. Iyer has scored 590 runs in the format under his captaincy, averaging around 35 at a strike rate of 152.45. Read more

In further updates, Star Imran Khan has received a second notice from the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO), asking him to explain why his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) status should not be cancelled following his participation in a Mumbai protest supporting the Cockroach Janta Party's campaign against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The notice gives him 15 days to respond and acknowledges that an FIR or detention alone does not establish grounds for cancellation. Khan had earlier challenged a separate notice directing him to leave India by October 28 before the Bombay High Court. Read more

title: Shilpa Shinde’s Goddess Sita act at Delhi Ramlila wins fans over, gets compared to Kriti Sanon, Sai Pallavi
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Shilpa Shinde , known for playing Angoori Bhabhi in Bhabhi Ji Ghar Par Hain , is back in the spotlight after her portrayal of Goddess Sita at a Ramlila in Delhi went widely shared on social media. The star, who won Bigg Boss 11, was seen wearing a saffron saree and a large Rudraksha garland as she enacted a scene from the Ramayana at the Shalimar Bagh Ramlila.

Adding to this, Shilpa Shinde portrayed Goddess Sita at a Delhi Ramlila. Shilpa plays Sita at Ramlila in Delhi In the video circulating online, Shilpa is seen as Mata Sita asking Lakshman to look for Lord Rama. Lakshman initially refuses to leave her alone, concerned about her safety. Her performance caught the attention of followers online. One comment read, “She looks pretty,” while another shared, “Better choice than Kriti and Sai Pallavi.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Priyanka Manchanda (@classymissysassy)

Notably, Shilpa has been a familiar face on Indian television for years. She appeared in several shows before landing the role of Angoori Bhabhi in the sitcom Bhabhi Ji Ghar Par Hain, which made her a household name. However, her stint on the show ended amid a public dispute with the makers. After a bitter nine-year fallout, Shilpa Shinde reprised her iconic role as Angoori Bhabhi in 2025 for the show's revamped version, Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain 2.0.

As per the latest buzz, Over the years, Shilpa has also appeared in television shows such as Lapataganj, Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev, Do Dil Ek Jaan, Chidiya Ghar and Maayka, among others. She, however, maintains alow profile and prefers to stay away from the media eye.

In further updates, Shilpa later participated in Bigg Boss 11, where her straightforward personality and interactions with fellow contestants made her one of the season’s most talked-about participants. She eventually emerged as the winner. Over the years, she has also appeared on reality shows such as Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 10 and Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 14.

On top of that, Shilpa Shinde’s stint on Ektaa Kapoor’s reality show Lock Upp also made headlines. She was initially seen as a contestant who often found herself at the centre of arguments in the house. However, as the show progressed, her friendship with Shreya Kalra became a talking point, and several contestants and viewers began rooting for her.
Shilpa finished as the third runner-up on the show, while Shreya Kalra won the season and received the ₹ 1 crore rupees cash prize. Shivangi Joshi finished as the runner-up.
